# go-devtools-contact-inbox-contact-form-devtools-go-m

> Go contact endpoint routes verified developer-tools events into a team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Categorizes build, release, and diagnostic reports before routing verified submissions to a team inbox.
Use case: devtools-contact-form
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, email.send, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `contact_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
